title: Отец Насти нападает на Шефа  (Nastya's Father Tackles the Chef)

segments.t: After Vika tells Max she refuses to repeat her past mistakes, Nastya's father storms into the restaurant looking for the man who picked up the ransom bag. Spotting Chef Barinov holding a bag, he tackles Viktor Petrovich to the floor until Nastya runs out shouting for her dad to stop.
Потому что я не буду повторять свои ошибки.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.
'And nothing can be fixed anymore.' Barinov explains that nothing can be fixed anymore, keeping his voice calm and direct.

'Because I am not going to repeat my old mistakes.' Realizing that because she is not going to repeat her old mistakes changes how Vika handles the situation.

'Wait, do you want a snail?' Checking whether Barinov wants a snail is how Nastya puts Barinov on the spot. In Russian, she does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
'Right here in our kitchen.' Over the truth and the restaurant, Barinov answers Nastya without a second thought.

'Dad, I am right here!' Declaring that dad she is right here brings Nastya's temper right to the surface. Russian puts the key word right up front so her emotion lands on the first beat.
'Well, basically.' With the plan and restaurant in play, Barinov keeps this short reply brisk and direct. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.

That wraps up this scene as spotting Chef Barinov carrying a plastic bag in the restaurant, Nastya's father mistakes him for the kidnapper and tackles him until Nastya runs out to stop the fight. See you next time!
